claim.purpose: Schedule the Agent Logic account repository migration as planning-only v0.92 work

initial.title: [v0.92][planning][github] Schedule Agent Logic account repository migration
initial.goal: Make the planning-only Agent Logic account repository migration visible in the canonical v0.92 issue-wave authority.
initial.required_outcome: The v0.92 planning authority contains one source-grounded reference to the migration plan and preserves all Gate 0 prerequisites and non-claims.
authority_boundary: The TBD migration plan remains the planning source
No GitHub or repository mutation is authorized
initial.task_boundary: Add one bounded planning-only reference for the migration plan to the v0.92 issue-wave authority.
acceptance_criteria: The entry names destination organization, owners, six candidates, billing/security confirmation, and asksifu exclusion as unresolved Gate 0 prerequisites
No transfer or approval claim is introduced
A bounded review confirms the edit is planning-only
non_goals: Remote, Actions, Pages, DNS, secret, workflow, or permission changes
initial.plan_summary: Add the smallest source-grounded v0.92 planning reference, validate it, review it, and publish a PR without performing migration work.

steps.action: Add the bounded migration scheduling reference to the v0.92 issue-wave YAML
Run focused YAML/diff validation and exact-head review before publication

invariants: asksifu is never a migration candidate
No tracked edit occurs on main
risks: The TBD source plan is intentionally local and ignored; the YAML reference must remain truthful about that boundary
stop_conditions: Any request to transfer or configure GitHub
Any need to edit files outside the declared scope

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate YAML structure, reference text, and diff scope

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed if the reference is missing, the scope widens, or the edit implies migration authorization.
review_prompts: Does the reference preserve planning-only truth?
initial.review_scope: Only the v0.92 YAML scheduling reference and its direct wording.
